title: Verblocks carry history and prose against hv's rule, and nothing in Intent says or checks so: IN-PR-STYLE-005, a staged-markdown verblock guard, and two pointers
body:
## What happens

Agents' folds write narratives and earlier versions into verblocks, against hv's rule. hv, 2026-10-12: "The verblock just has 1-line (or less) text plus the version and NEVER has history in it. That is what version control is for!" That rule lived only in other estates' project memories, so Intent's sessions never saw it: intent/wip.md's verblock carried a fold's narrative, and two of ST0056's attachments carried earlier versions. Those live docs were cut in dbfc3fc10. Intent has no rule, guard or pointer that says so, and its headless critic runs no markdown (`HEADLESS_LANGUAGES` in critic.rs names elixir, rust, swift, lua and shell), so a library rule on its own refuses nothing.

## Expected

hv's ruling of 2026-10-26, by TUI in molt-vc's session, taking vc's proposal as recommended. hv's words for the rule: "THE VERBLOCK IS NOT A REPLACEMENT FOR VERSION CONTROL. DO NOT STORE PROSE IN THE VERBLOCK. Just the docs version and a short -- no more than 1-line -- text about the current version." It is going-forward only (hv: "This is going-forward only."), so records are left as they are.

- (a) A library rule, IN-PR-STYLE-005, beside the house-style rule IN-PR-STYLE-001, holds hv's two statements verbatim as its Problem, with the cut in dbfc3fc10 as its Bad and Good.
- (a) A shipped pre-commit guard, `verblock-guard.sh`, runs beside `staged-format-guard.sh` on STAGED markdown only, so a record nobody restages is never read.
- (a) Two pointer lines cite the rule's ID and do not restate it: the Markdown line of `lib/templates/llm/_AGENTS.md`, and the `wip.md` step of in-finish.
- (b) The guard refuses a verblock carrying a second version stamp, and a quoted value longer than 100 characters.
- (c) It ships in 3.2.7. Its bank carries the rule file, the guard with one red and one green arm per refusal, the two pointer lines, AGENTS.md regenerated, the CHANGELOG line and the MODULES row. The template and the guard are live on save in every estate, so it is built in a detached worktree and judged in Intent's train.

## Where it lives today (measured at 26a531712)

- The shipped guards are in `lib/templates/hooks/`, beside `staged-format-guard.sh`, and `pre-commit-guards.sh` runs them.
- The prose base's style rules are in `intent/plugins/claude/rules/prose/style/` (IN-PR-STYLE-001 to 004).
- The AGENTS.md template names verblock frontmatter at `lib/templates/llm/_AGENTS.md` line 147, and in-finish's fold rewrites `intent/wip.md` at its "Update `intent/wip.md` with:" step.
- After dbfc3fc10, every live verblock in this tree carries one stamp and is 77 characters or shorter, so the guard reds nothing when it lands.
